name: Delayed FNOL
description: First notification of loss reported more than 24 hours after date of loss without documented impediment
recommendedAction: Request timeline statement and corroborating evidence for reporting delay

name: Photo metadata predates loss
description: Uploaded damage photographs created before the reported date of loss
recommendedAction: Suspend settlement; request original device metadata and forensic image review

name: Recent cover upgrade
description: Material cover enhancement (protected NCB, reduced excess) within 30 days before loss
recommendedAction: Review policy change rationale and underwriting notes before indemnity decision

name: Missing police report
description: Motor accident with third party involvement but no police report filed
recommendedAction: Request police reference or statutory declaration explaining non-reporting

name: No independent witnesses
description: High-value motor claim with no witnesses and sole policyholder account
recommendedAction: Seek CCTV, dashcam, or third-party trace for corroboration

name: Rapid repair estimate
description: Repair estimate supplied within 4 hours of claim notification
recommendedAction: Validate garage relationship and independent engineer assessment

name: Garage frequency cluster
description: Repair garage appears on multiple claims in a 60-day window
recommendedAction: Flag garage for network fraud review and cross-claim linkage analysis

name: Settlement account change
description: Bank account for settlement updated within 48 hours of claim submission
recommendedAction: Verify account ownership via payee checks before any payment

name: Device linked to investigations
description: Submission device matches device used on unrelated policy applications under investigation
recommendedAction: Link to SIU identity graph and check for synthetic identity indicators

name: Pressure for expedited settlement
description: Expedited settlement requested with multiple service contacts in first 24 hours
recommendedAction: Apply standard fraud hold; document customer pressure pattern

name: High indemnity ratio
description: Claim value exceeds 50% of estimated vehicle market value
recommendedAction: Order independent vehicle inspection and market valuation

name: Quote shopping pattern
description: Multiple quote attempts on same customer email before binding
recommendedAction: Review quote history for premium manipulation or fronting signals

name: Salesforce fraud flag
description: Claim already flagged or contains fraud escalation notes on Claim__c
recommendedAction: Align profiler outcome with existing SIU notes on the Salesforce record

name: Channel corroboration gap
description: Slack claims channel discussion contradicts or omits facts on the Salesforce claim record
recommendedAction: Reconcile channel transcript with FNOL and interview handler

name: Channel fraud escalation mention
description: Claims channel contains SIU, fraud, or suspect language linked to this claim reference
recommendedAction: Pull full channel export and align with profiling score before settlement

name: Vehicle identity mismatch
description: Damage photo vehicle make, model, colour, or registration inconsistent with insured vehicle on Claim__c
recommendedAction: Hold settlement; verify VRM and vehicle identity against policy schedule and DVLA
